answer: Make each identity complete a voyage across three unrelated kinds of work, each step attested by a different independent expert. Every expert may vouch from a single ledge: one attestation per epoch, consumed when used, and the expert loses standing if the work proves fake. The meadow of willing experts is finite, so a farm needing three fresh experts per clone quickly exhausts it, while one honest agent needs only three. Cloning therefore multiplies scarce expert cost without multiplying reward.
